criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use an elevated orthographic-isometric view with vertical structures and diagonal ground axes.
Both frame a broad playable city between fixed side overlays.
different: CANDIDATE is framed slightly higher and wider, so buildings and poles appear smaller.
CANDIDATE exposes more peripheral terrain while REFERENCE keeps the built world tighter.

evidence.observation: Elevated isometric map with diagonal roads and tightly framed industrial districts.
Matching isometric axes and pitch, but a wider world extent is visible.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both maps combine dense housing, industrial compounds, roads, and repeated utility structures.
Both distribute major built clusters around a rougher central corridor.
different: REFERENCE sustains finer occupied detail across more of the map surface.
CANDIDATE separates its city clusters with broader dark terrain and water gaps.

evidence.observation: Roads, rubble, facilities, and settlements occupy most of the visible world.
Dense perimeter settlements surround larger sparse rocky and river areas.
Large southeastern city mass is dense but distinctly isolated from other clusters.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both use subdued dark-blue water against deep rocky banks.
Neither water surface has bright or glossy reflections.
different: REFERENCE shows only a narrow cropped water feature at the lower-left edge.
CANDIDATE makes a deep winding channel and attached bridge a central geographic feature.

evidence.observation: A small dark-blue channel is partly visible along the lower-left boundary.
A broad curved river crosses much of the central and lower map.
A prominent bridge attaches to the upper river crossing.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: In both, pylons are roughly comparable to low-rise building height.
Plants and substations remain larger multi-part silhouettes than houses.
different: REFERENCE gives its major plants and stacks slightly stronger silhouette dominance.
CANDIDATE's wider framing makes ordinary facilities and poles read somewhat smaller.

evidence.observation: Large stack plant visibly dominates nearby pylons and small structures.
Tower, substation, and neighborhood proportions form a consistent hierarchy.
Plants, pylons, and city blocks retain similar relative size relationships.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use blackened bolted metal, dark concrete, stony soil, and restrained midtones.
Amber lamps and cyan electrical accents provide the same limited color contrast.
different: CANDIDATE is warmer and more midtone-crushed across the terrain.
REFERENCE has cooler blue-gray separation and slightly crisper surface cohesion.

evidence.observation: Black steel plates, bolts, bevels, and amber accents define the chrome.
Closely matching bolted black-metal chrome spans the top edge.
Cool charcoal terrain preserves visible stone, road, and concrete midtones.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both distinguish two competing routes with cyan and amber conductors.
Both repeat tower silhouettes along readable paths with marked nodes and endpoints.
different: REFERENCE also presents continuous glowing cyan energized feeders; CANDIDATE relies mostly on thin dashed route strokes.
CANDIDATE's lower amber route merges more with roads and industrial clutter.

evidence.observation: Bright solid feeders and dotted cyan/amber alternatives visibly attach towers and substations.
Cyan and amber dashed alternatives link repeated poles over the city.
Amber conductors overlap a dark road corridor, weakening attachment clarity.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both use a bolted top status bar, vertical left kit, and tall right route inspector.
Both integrate amber/cyan card borders over a central map with comparable overlay ratios.
different: CANDIDATE's inspector has a large empty lower chamber and much sparser comparison metrics.
REFERENCE gives the inspector denser hierarchy, larger metrics, and direct paired build actions.

evidence.observation: Segmented industrial status chrome spans the full top width.
A similarly proportioned segmented status bar uses matching steel construction.
Two information-dense route cards and paired actions fill the right inspector.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both strips are independent four-part bars centered at the bottom with nearly identical footprint.
Both use bolted dark chrome and distinct active/inactive cyan-amber states; CANDIDATE visibly shows progress, result, and next stages.
different: CANDIDATE uses unequal, text-dense stage segments while REFERENCE uses compact, more even controls.

evidence.observation: Four compact playback segments form a centered bolted bottom strip.
Four event stages show completion, active test, result, and next-state legibility in the same footprint.
